examiner (exam-2), measured at BASE with the exam on the tree:

- leg (a)'s stateExam is red exactly as the absent box: `act: no element matches role=textbox name="Tags for walk the dog"`. Leg (b) is red on `#tags-0`/`#tags-1` being absent from the static render (the row-id and expected-file pins beside them pass, so the red is the box and not the fixture).
- `bun run lint:state` at BASE reports exactly one finding, and it is this exam's own view over the state the box does not paint yet: `tests/state-exams/type-tags.test.ts: view #tags-0 over state-exams/expected/two-todos-second-tagged.json: no match has value="" — the matches carry value=`. That one finding is what makes `packages/tinyapp-lint/test/views.test.ts (a)` and `lint-cli.test.ts (a)` red at BASE, and through them `styled-page.test.ts` leg (f), and through that leg (c) of this exam. So leg (c) is red at BASE too, transitively for the same absent implementation; it goes green when the box paints `#tags-0` with `value=""`. Without this exam file on the tree `bun test packages/tinyapp-lint` is 28 pass / 0 fail, so nothing else on the tree is broken.
- leg (c) is registered only when `TINYAPP_STYLED_PAGE_NESTED` is unset. `styled-page.test.ts` leg (f) runs `bun test tests/state-exams` — the directory this file lives in — with that marker set, and skips its own suite lines under it; without the same guard here the Run line would re-enter itself through that child. The outer run — the Proof's Run line and the driver's `bun test tests/state-exams/type-tags.test.ts` — has the marker unset, so the leg is live where it is graded. Precedent and marker are styled-page's own.
